milestone.title: Test infrastructure refactor — ac_verify pipe deadlock, AC+step unification, scope discipline

intent.outcome: mp's test runner is reliable (no deadlocks on chatty processes), consistent (AC and step verifications share a single runner), and scoped to the milestone's affected crates — so future milestones don't rediscover the 'verification timed out after 300s' failure mode that blocked M104.

problem.description: Three coupled defects. (1) crates/mp/src/ac_verify.rs::execute reads child stdout/stderr only at child exit; cargo compile output fills the macOS pipe buffer, blocks on write, the verifier's try_wait loop never sees child exit until the 300s gate fires. Symptom: mp milestone complete cannot pass any milestone with a cargo test AC verification on cold cache; M104 stalled here twice in one session. (2) verify_milestone_in and verify_step_tests_in are parallel codepaths sharing a Kind enum and shell-out pattern but owning separate report-envelope types — duplicated and drift-prone. (3) The 'AC verification strings should be scoped to affected crates' rule lives in a dogfood-log entry, not in the tooling or the milestone-planning checklist — the next milestone author will hit the same trap M104 did.

in_scope: Replace ac_verify::execute's drain-at-exit loop with a per-pipe reader thread (std::thread, not tokio).
Unify verify_milestone_in and verify_step_tests_in behind a shared runner; keep two thin envelope builders for callers (AcResult, StepTestsResult shapes unchanged).

AGENTS.md / milestone planning checklist note: AC verification strings must be scoped to the milestone's affected crates (cargo test -p <crate> -p <crate>); broad scopes (--workspace, --all, make test) belong in CI, not in mp milestone complete's gate.
Soft lint: warn (not block) when verification strings match --workspace, --all, or `make test` patterns. Surface via a make verify-lint (or equivalent) target or pre-commit hook.

Test audit doc: enumerate current test files / fixtures / scenarios; classify each (keep / drop / investigate); list coverage gaps. Output as docs/TEST-AUDIT.md or crates/mp/TEST_AUDIT.md (Q-02). No bulk deletes in this milestone — decisions documented for the next dogfood pass.
Coverage gap analysis: confirm M104's additions (sort regression, lifecycle parity) are still green and replicable; flag any other under-tested surface from the audit.
out_of_scope: Switching mp to async / tokio runtime.
M104 itself (functionally done; will complete after this milestone ships via the now-working verifier).
Bumping DEFAULT_VERIFY_TIMEOUT_SECS (scope discipline replaces this — the 300s ceiling remains as a forcing function).
Bulk deletion or mass restructuring of existing tests (audit decisions land in the next dogfood pass, not this commit).

acceptance_criteria.description: Replacing ac_verify::execute with a per-pipe reader-thread drain makes a M104-style verification string (cargo test -p mp -p raul && mp validate --summary) finish in <60s on warm target/. On cold target/, the verifier completes without hitting the 300s gate (the deadlock fix is observable). Manual reproduction: clean target/, re-run mp milestone complete 104 (which had its ACs narrowed during M104 work), observe no 300s gate fire even without redirect hacks.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo test -p mp -p raul && mp validate --summary && mp milestone complete 104 --force

acceptance_criteria.description: verify_milestone_in and verify_step_tests_in share one classifier and one runner. External behavior (AcResult, StepTestsResult shapes, the mp milestone complete payload, mp reviews step-tests output) is unchanged. Existing milestone integration tests and make test pass without modification.

A soft lint surfaces a warning (does NOT block the gate) when any verification string in any milestone matches --workspace, --all, or `make test` patterns. M104, whose historical AC-04 once read `make test && mp validate`, is unblocked after the lint addition even if the historical string is still on disk; the warning is recorded in the lint report and explicitly NOT a gate failure.
acceptance_criteria.verification: make verify-lint && cargo test -p mp -p raul

acceptance_criteria.description: Test audit doc (docs/TEST-AUDIT.md or crates/mp/TEST_AUDIT.md, per Q-02) enumerates current test files / fixtures / scenarios and classifies each as keep / drop / investigate. Coverage gaps from the audit are listed. The doc is the basis for any subsequent test-cleanup decisions (NOT in this milestone's commit set).

cargo test -p mp -p raul exits 0 and mp validate --summary exits 0/0. No flake introduced — existing tests behave identically before and after the refactor (covered by AC-02's full test pass + manual spot-check on previously-passing tests).
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo test -p mp -p raul && mp validate --summary

design_decisions.rationale: The deadlock is a small localized fix; tokio would pull a runtime + async migration of every verifier call site (verify_milestone, run_step_test, all integration tests), and blow the make dep-audit transitive budget. std::thread adds zero deps, matches mp's pure-sync style, and the fix is local to ac_verify::execute.

The 300s timeout stays as a forcing function. The lint makes scope violations visible without breaking pending milestones whose historical AC strings predate the lint (e.g., M104's earlier `make test && mp validate`). Hard blocking would entangle this milestone with completion of those stragglers.

design_decisions.choice: Shared runner, two thin envelope builders
design_decisions.rationale: Keep AcResult / StepTestsResult as caller-facing shapes (avoid changing CLI output or downstream JSON consumers). Move the duplicated shell-out-and-classify into one runner. ~50 lines of dedup, zero external behavior change.

design_decisions.choice: Classify first; delete in a later milestone
design_decisions.rationale: Bulk deletion in this milestone would risk regressing tests whose coverage is implicit. Audit decisions land in the doc; the next dogfood pass (or a follow-up milestone) acts on them. Keeps blast radius tight.

open_questions.question: Should the soft lint live as a make verify-lint target, a pre-commit hook, or both? Cheap to add either.
open_questions.answer:
make verify-lint target only. A pre-commit hook adds per-developer setup cost for marginal value; a Master Plan — common targets

open_questions.question: Audit doc location: docs/ (project-level, observable from repo root) vs crates/mp/TEST_AUDIT.md (crate-local, lives next to the code it audits) vs master-plan/ (alongside other audit notes)?
open_questions.answer: docs/TEST-AUDIT.md (project-level, repo root). The audit spans both crates/mp and crates/raul and is referenced from AGENTS.md / project docs, so a single doc at repo root is the right home.
